meta_description: Done-for-you security review workflow for B2B SaaS teams selling to enterprise. Intake, evidence, drafting, approvals, and submission on a 48-hour SLA.
for_whom: For 5-100 person B2B SaaS and AI teams selling to mid-market or enterprise
hero_headline: Turn the next security review into a clean 48-hour workflow
hero_subheadline: We handle intake, evidence gathering, first-pass answers, approval routing, and final submission so your deal does not turn into founder chaos.
secondary_cta_text: Ask for a redacted sample pack
credibility_line: NDA-friendly, least-privilege access, and nothing is submitted without your approval.
pain_paragraph: Security reviews stall deals because the work lands across sales, founders, engineering, and compliance at once. The result is scattered docs, slow turnarounds, inconsistent answers, and avoidable risk right when you are supposed to build trust.
before: A prospect sends a spreadsheet or portal invite and nobody clearly owns it
Evidence lives across Drive, Notion, Slack, and random old PDFs
Founders and engineers get pulled into repetitive copy-paste work
Deals slow down because answers are late or inconsistent
after: One intake inbox and tracker for every security request
Reusable evidence library and approved answer bank
A clean submission pack and audit trail for every request
offer_summary: Security Review Inbox is the operating layer for customer security requests. We organize your materials, draft the first pass, route approvals, and ship a submission-ready package on time.
included: Security request intake form and tracker
Evidence vault structure with naming conventions
First-pass response drafting from approved source material
Final submission pack in spreadsheet, portal, or PDF format
Weekly queue summary with turnaround and blocker notes
excluded: Writing brand new policies from scratch
Pen tests, audits, or unsupported security claims
Owning customer calls as your security spokesperson
process: Fit call to confirm volume, buyer type, and current workflow
Onboarding: set up intake, evidence vault, answer bank, and approval path
For each request: intake, draft, internal review, approval, and final submission
Weekly review to update the bank, tighten response time, and remove repeat blockers
pricing_headline: Starter pilot: $750 for one security review
pricing_details: Ongoing service starts at $1,500 onboarding + $2,000/mo for up to 4 security requests per month. Extra request volume, portals, or tighter SLAs are scoped separately.
guarantee_line: If we miss the agreed 48-hour first-pass SLA, that request is free.

faq.q: How do you handle security and access?
faq.a: Least-privilege access only. Usually that means a shared folder, a tracker, and temporary portal access if needed. No production credentials, and NDA is fine.

faq.q: What do you need before starting?
faq.a: At minimum: your current security docs, any past questionnaire answers, a named approver, and one place where we can collect evidence. If the docs are messy, we can still start by organizing them.
Usually 60 to 90 minutes of working time across one kickoff, document collection, and approval-path setup. After that, each new request is run through the same workflow.

faq.q: How long do you retain our materials?
faq.a: Only as long as needed for active work and the reusable answer bank you approve. We can set a fixed retention window and delete on request.

faq.q: Is this a fit if we are pre-SOC 2?
faq.a: Yes, if you already get security requests and want a cleaner process. We do not invent claims. We package what is true, highlight gaps clearly, and keep approvals tight.

trust_basics_line: Works best when you already have some security materials and a named internal approver. Not a fit if you need a full compliance program built from zero.
